title: Monitor autoconfig: survive boot, biggest monitor primary
objective: DP-2 (4K) connects automatically on every boot and hotplug with no manual xrandr: the watcher waits for X at the LightDM greeter instead of crashing, and the biggest monitor becomes primary and leftmost.
acceptance_criteria: plan(outputs) with no primary named puts the largest native mode first at 0x0 with --primary
_open_display retries on DisplayConnectionError instead of exiting
unit sets XAUTHORITY=%h/.Xauthority; i3 config restarts the unit on login/reload
live: xrandr --listmonitors shows DP-2 primary 3840x2160+0+0 and HDMI-0 at +3840+0
